arabic text: Laashe utha rahe hai azadar subho shaam\nSine pe haath lab pe hai labbayk ya imam\nNaara laga rahe hai shahadat ka peeke jaam
english translation text: The mourners carry bodies morning and evening;\nwith hands upon their chests and 'Labbayk, O Imam' upon their lips,\nthey raise the cry of martyrdom after drinking its cup.

arabic text: Dil se ghame husain nikala kabhi nahin\nSir zaalimon ke dar pe jhukaya kabhi nahin\nJo aap se hai ishk chupaya kabhi nahin
english translation text: We never removed Hussain's grief from our hearts;\nwe never bowed our heads before the doors of tyrants;\nand we never concealed the love we hold for you.

arabic text: Awlaade fatema pe hai ab bhi sitam rawaan\nHai karbala me ek nai karbala bapa\nPhirse nikal rahi hai bas ab to yehi dua
english translation text: Oppression still continues against Fatima's children;\na new Karbala has arisen within Karbala.\nOnce again, only this prayer rises from our hearts.

arabic text: Har shehr har zameen hai aqaa lahu lahu\nGulshan lahu lahu hai to sehra lahu lahu\nPhirse huwa furaat ka darya lahu lahu
english translation text: Every city and every land, O Master, is soaked in blood;\nthe garden is bloodied, the wilderness is bloodied,\nand once again the river Euphrates has turned blood-red.

arabic text: Qasre yazeediat yuhi dhaate rahenge hum\nFirauniat ka naam mitate rahenge hum\nAbbas ke alam ko uthaate rahenge hum
english translation text: We will continue to demolish the palaces of Yazidism;\nwe will continue to erase the name of tyranny;\nand we will continue to raise Abbas's standard.

arabic text: Jaan apni yeh zafar dare zahra pe waarna\nNa haarna ai momino himmat na harna\nApne imam e waqt ko yuhi pukaarna
english translation text: O "Zafar", sacrifice your life at Zahra's door.\nO believers, do not lose—never lose your courage;\ncontinue to call upon the Imam of your age.
